description: Sudan Floods 27th of October 2019 is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Sudan. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2025-04-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
